response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_average FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_average FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), overall_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS benchmark FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_average FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob WHERE ca.country_average > ob.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS benchmark FROM above_overall) SELECT ao.country, ao.country_average AS average, ao.country_average - ob.benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark, ao.country_average - sb.benchmark AS above_second_mean FROM above_overall AS ao CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS sb WHERE ao.country_average > sb.benchmark ORDER BY ao.country;
